mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals an impending monetary policy easing, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises above 5.5% but S&P 500 20d returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3% year-over-year), rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals economic overheating and potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3%), RSAFS rises but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals an overheating labor market that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of PAYEMS and UNRATE (with UNRATE < 4.5%) fails to predict negative returns: 20d forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below -0.5% month-over-month signals an imminent economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below -0.5% MoM but S&P 500 5d returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic activity and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST is above the 5-year average but S&P 500 60d returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3%) and stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS >= 4.0%) signals an active monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS >= 4.0%, S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 60% of cases.
